/screeners/vrp_scanner.query:
query FeatureCatalogue {
    catalogue {
      name
      kind
      source
      dtype
      format
      description
      nullMeaning
      version
      group
      key
      inputs
      unit
      range
      categories
      scope
      owner
      licence
      guide {
        theme
        reads
        summary
      }
    }
  }

/admin/ingestion.query:
query NightlyRuns($limit: Int!) {
    nightlyRuns(limit: $limit) {
      runId
      session
      status
      startedAt
      durationS
      problems
      steps {
        name
        status
        durationS
        reason
        error
        origin
        originDurationS
        startedAt
        needs
        rerunsAfter
      }
    }
  }

/admin/llm-usage.query:
query LlmUsage($recent: Int!) {
    llmUsage(recent: $recent) {
      today
      recorded
      budget {
        dailyUsd
        monthlyUsd
        over
        reportedCallUsd
        error
      }
      windows {
        key
        start
        end
        cap {
          kind
          limitUsd
          usedShare
        }
        tally {
          calls
          inputTokens
          outputTokens
          cacheReadTokens
          cacheWriteTokens
          totalInputTokens
          callsWithoutTotalInput
          callsWithoutTokens
          spentUsd
          billedUsd
          reportedUsd
          boundUsd
          freeCalls
          unknown {
            code
            kind
            guideTerm
            kindText
          }
        }
      }
      breakdowns {
        by
        rows {
          key
          provider
          costShare
          tally {
            calls
            inputTokens
            outputTokens
            cacheReadTokens
            cacheWriteTokens
            totalInputTokens
            callsWithoutTotalInput
            callsWithoutTokens
            spentUsd
            billedUsd
            reportedUsd
            boundUsd
          }
        }
      }
      daily {
        day
        tally {
          calls
          inputTokens
          outputTokens
          cacheReadTokens
          cacheWriteTokens
          totalInputTokens
          spentUsd
          reportedUsd
          unknown {
            code
            kind
            guideTerm
            kindText
          }
        }
      }
      reliability {
        attempts
        ok
        fellBack
        failed
        skippedBudget
        rejected
        fallbackRate
        failureRate
      }
      recent {
        ts
        provider
        model
        useCase
        user
        inputTokens
        outputTokens
        cacheReadTokens
        cacheWriteTokens
        totalInputTokens
        latencyS
        costUsd
        costBasis
        outcome
        fellBackFrom
        runId
        error
        stage
        sentence
        answer
        promptChars
        callId
        promptVersion
        callStage
        unknownFields
        unknown {
          code
          kind
          guideTerm
          kindText
          cause {
            links {
              level
              subject
              status
              message
              runId
            }
          }
        }
      }
      failures {
        ts
        provider
        model
        useCase
        user
        inputTokens
        outputTokens
        cacheReadTokens
        cacheWriteTokens
        totalInputTokens
        latencyS
        costUsd
        costBasis
        outcome
        fellBackFrom
        runId
        error
        stage
        sentence
        answer
        promptChars
        callId
        promptVersion
        callStage
        unknownFields
        unknown {
          code
          kind
          guideTerm
          kindText
          cause {
            links {
              level
              subject
              status
              message
              runId
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

/admin/harness-runs.query:
query HarnessRuns($limit: Int!) {
    harnessRuns(limit: $limit) {
      runId
      edgeId
      user
      status
      startedAt
      finishedAt
      rangeFrom
      rangeTo
      splitFrom
      exploratory
      variants
      horizons
      sessions
      unclosed
      excludedCoverage
      scoreCoverage
      noEntryBar
      trials
      knowledgeTs
      asOf
    }
  }
